paper_id: ERA-CoT_ Improving Chain-of-Thought through Entity Relationship Analysis__oa_W4392737534
title: ERA-CoT: Improving Chain-of-Thought through Entity Relationship Analysis
motivation: LLMs处理多实体复杂场景时遇到挑战,隐式关系需要多步推理,但CoT缺乏实体关系理解能力
problem_framing: 将复杂场景问答建模为实体关系分析+链式推理的5步pipeline问题
key_insight: 通过显式关系提取→隐式关系推理→关系判别过滤,可增强LLM对实体关系的理解从而提升推理准确性
method_signature: 5步pipeline:实体提取→显式关系→隐式推理→阈值过滤→问答
evaluation_criteria: Accuracy和Exact Match在6个数据集上对比baseline方法
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 在符号推理等实体关系较少的任务上性能提升不明显,且k值过大时会引入幻觉
evidence_for_taste: Implicit Relationship Inference Errors is consistently the highest
the error rate of An. is relatively small
if the relationships between entities are correctly inferred, the model is likely to answer questions correctly
Even simple sentences can contain some in-depth entity relationships worth exploring
thinking_moves: 把问答中的多实体关系问题拆解为串行的子任务pipeline
用Self-Consistency投票机制验证实体提取和显式关系的一致性
通过阈值过滤消除推理过程中的错误隐式关系
区分简单问题(k=1)和复杂问题(k>3)的隐式关系数量需求
